Please make sure you have the correct access rights
and the repository exists.

Birth-cloud dust is on by default again. I changed `"birth_cloud_dust"` back to `True` in the SETTINGS cell of `notebooks/ceridwen_integrated_photometry_spectra.ipynb`, which undoes `ada7b92`. The wiki model page (`wiki/notes/model.md`) already says "On", so it needed no change. Nothing was run to test this; it's a one-word settings change.

It's committed on `absorption-mask` as `f7451fd`, but the push failed because this sandbox blocks github.com. Run `git push` yourself to send it.

The `ceridwen` submodule has uncommitted changes that I didn't make, so I left them out of the commit.
